coverage.notes: All figures are GFP survey-based harvest projections ("Harvest Projections"), not check-station counts. Season rows (unit Statewide / East River / West River / Black Hills / CU1 etc. with no hunt code) come from the multi-year comparison table in GFP's most recent report for that season; unit and hunt rows come from each year's projection and distribution tables (2020-2024: GFP annual Big Game Harvest Projections reports; 2025+: GFP's current season reports). Rows labelled '— harvest by unit' are GFP harvest-distribution tables for statewide licenses: they give harvest by the unit where the animal was taken and carry no hunters or success; GFP rounds each unit, so their sum can differ from GFP's total by a few percent. daysHunted is GFP's average days hunted per hunter. licenses = licenses sold (resident + nonresident where GFP prints both). 2020-2025. Hunt rows carry GFP's unit-type code (e.g. H2A-21); licenses = resident licenses sold (SD elk is resident-only). Custer State Park antlerless elk was closed 2019-2025. Landowner Own Land Prairie Elk projections are tabulated only for 2024-2025. 2025 archery H5A-21 (1 license, no survey response) printed no harvest and is omitted. GFP does not name elk units in these reports.

Youth Deer was part of Apprentice Deer in 2018-2020 (Youth rows start 2021). National Wildlife Refuge tables list whitetail only. West River 2020 hunt 45C-19: GFP left the nonresident-sold cell blank, so licenses is omitted (resident sold is in the note). 2025 West River LOL WR1-01 has blank harvest cells read as 0 after confirming against GFP's Totals row. 'Archery Deer — nonresident license types' (2023+) re-tabulates the nonresident ST1-01/LM1-13 archery rows by nonresident license type (ADN / ADNP), so do not add the two together. Hunt codes are GFP unit-license-type codes (e.g. 01A-01); license-area codes ST1/LM1/APD/YOD/MHD are reported under unit 'Statewide' and ER1/WR1 under 'East River'/'West River'.

GFP survey projections for the Black Hills season (Dec 26 - Apr 30) excluding Custer State Park / Dog Access Permit Area, and for CSP / Dog Access Permit holders, from GFP's 2025/26 report comparison tables. Each season is recorded under the license year in which it ends (2019/20 -> 2020 ... 2025/26 -> 2026). hunters = GFP projected active hunters; successPct = harvest / active hunters (computed), except the 2025/26 Dog Access Permit row, which uses GFP's published permit-holder active hunters and success (CSP was open to all license holders that season). Prairie (outside the Black Hills Fire Protection District) lion harvest, which GFP reports only in its narrative text, is not included.
